patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-resolution product photography dominates each scroll section, often serving as the primary visual element with minimal, centered text overlays.
A highly stylized, wide, and thin sans-serif display font is used for key product names ('TRANSPORT'), contrasting with a clean, modern sans-serif for all other headings and body text.
The site uses a stark, high-contrast palette of deep charcoal/black backgrounds with crisp white or light grey typography, emphasizing the metallic and reflective qualities of the product.

The hero product image and main title ('TRANSPORT') exhibit a subtle parallax effect, moving at a slower rate than the scroll, creating a sense of depth against the dark background. Subsequent content sections reveal with a smooth slide-up and fade-in animation as they enter the viewport.
Content is organized into distinct, full-screen sections, each introduced by a large product image and a concise, benefit-oriented heading, creating a narrative flow as the user scrolls.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a 3D rendered product model (likely WebGL/Three.js) that subtly parallaxes against a static background as the user scrolls, giving a sense of depth and premium quality. Subsequent content sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, where large, full-bleed images and associated text elements slide up and fade into view with a smooth transition. The top navigation bar remains fixed, providing persistent access to site navigation.
The overall visual presentation relies on dramatic, high-fidelity product renders or photography, often against a dark, minimalist backdrop, to convey a sense of luxury and advanced technology.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, thin, uppercase display headings (~4-5x body) for product names, with smaller, clean sans-serif for feature descriptions and labels.
design_tokens.radius: sharp — all elements, including buttons and image containers, feature crisp, unrounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — generous negative space surrounds key elements and text blocks, particularly in the hero and feature sections, creating a sense of luxury and focus.

standout: The site's standout feature is its cinematic product presentation, using dramatic, full-bleed photography and subtle 3D parallax motion against a minimalist dark background to elevate a simple USB drive into a high-end, desirable object. It's less about features and more about the aspirational experience.
